meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How Nostr WoT handles your data on the website, in the browser extension, in the Nostr WoT iOS app and its hosted Lightning wallet, and in the Oracle API.

intro.description: This Privacy Policy describes how Nostr Web of Trust ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our website (nostrwot.com), our browser extension (WoT Extension) and the Nostr WoT app for iOS.
intro.commitment: We are committed to protecting your privacy. As a project built for the Nostr ecosystem, we understand the importance of decentralization and user sovereignty over personal data.

infoCollected.title: Information We Collect
infoCollected.description: When you visit our website, we may collect:

analytics.title: Analytics Data:
analytics.description: We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use our site. This includes anonymized information such as pages visited, time spent on site, browser type, device type, and approximate geographic location (country level).

contactForm.title: Contact Form Data:
contactForm.description: If you submit our contact form, we collect your name, email address, organization (if provided), and message content.

items.improve: To improve our website and documentation
items.respond: To respond to your inquiries and support requests

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: Our website uses cookies for analytics purposes. Google Analytics sets cookies to distinguish unique users and sessions. You can opt out of Google Analytics by installing the

extension.title: Browser Extension Privacy
extension.intro: The WoT Extension is designed with privacy as a core principle. Here's what you need to know:

pubkey.title: Your Pubkey:
pubkey.description: Stored locally in your browser to identify your position in the social graph. Never sent to our servers.

configuration.title: Configuration:
configuration.description: Your settings (operating mode, relay preferences, oracle URL) are stored locally in your browser.

localGraph.title: Local Graph Index:
localGraph.description: In Local or Hybrid mode, follow relationships are stored in your browser's IndexedDB. This data never leaves your device.

operatingModes.title: Operating Modes
operatingModes.description: The extension offers three operating modes with different privacy implications:

items.processedLocally: All queries are processed locally in your browser
items.fetchedDirectly: Follow data is fetched directly from Nostr relays
items.noDataSent: No data is sent to the WoT Oracle or our servers

items.sentToOracle: Queries are sent to the WoT Oracle API to calculate social distance
items.oracleSees: The Oracle sees which pubkeys you are querying (but not your identity unless you reveal it)
items.fasterResults: Provides faster results with less local storage
items.selfHost: Consider using a self-hosted Oracle for enhanced privacy

items.fallback: Falls back to Remote mode only when needed

doesNot.title: What the Extension Does NOT Do

items.browsingHistory: We do not collect or transmit your browsing history
items.ads: We do not inject ads or tracking scripts
items.sellData: We do not sell or share your data with third parties
items.privateKeys: We do not store your private keys (we never have access to them)
items.telemetry: We do not run analytics or telemetry in the extension

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: The extension requests the following browser permissions:

storage.title: Storage:
storage.description: To save your configuration and local graph index

scripting.title: Scripting:
scripting.description: To inject the window.nostr NIP-07 signer API into web pages

app.title: Nostr WoT App (iOS)
app.intro: Nostr WoT is an iPhone app that keeps your Nostr keys on your phone, signs for the apps you use and can connect a Lightning wallet. This section explains what the app keeps on your phone, what it sends over the network and to whom, and how to delete it.
app.publisher: The app is published on the App Store by DANDELION LABS JOINT STOCK COMPANY, which also operates the hosted Lightning wallet at zaps.nostr-wot.com. In this section, "we" means that company.

summary.title: In short
summary.description: You do not need an account with us to use the app. Your keys and seed phrase are encrypted on your phone and are never sent to us. The app has no analytics, no ads and no tracking, and we do not sell data. The only data we hold about you belongs to the hosted Lightning wallet, and only if you choose to use it.

onDevice.title: What stays on your phone
onDevice.description: The following is stored only on your phone. We cannot read it and it is not sent to us.

vault.title: Keys and seed phrases:
vault.description: Your private keys and seed phrase are kept in an encrypted vault (AES-256-GCM, with a key derived from your password or PIN using PBKDF2-SHA-256 and 600,000 iterations). An iPhone backup can include the vault, but only in encrypted form.

unlock.title: Password, PIN and Face ID:
unlock.description: You unlock the vault with a password or, if you prefer, a PIN that only works on this phone. Face ID is optional and handled by iOS: the app only learns whether the check passed and never sees your face data.

settings.title: Permissions, activity and settings:
settings.description: The rules you set for each app, your paired clients, the activity log, your relay lists and your other settings.

archive.title: Archive:
archive.description: If you use the Archive, each account keeps a copy of its own signed Nostr events in a local database, with every record encrypted under a key held in your vault. Archive files you export are encrypted with a password you choose.

walletSecrets.title: Wallet secrets:
walletSecrets.description: Nostr Wallet Connect connection strings and the keys of the self-custodial wallet are kept in the encrypted vault or encrypted with its key.

connections.title: What the app sends over the network
connections.description: The app connects to other services only to do what you ask. For each connection, here is who receives what.

relays.title: Nostr relays:
relays.description: Remote signing (NIP-46), the events you sign and publish, your post-quantum key attestation and the Archive use Nostr relays, which you can choose and change. Signing requests are end-to-end encrypted, but relays see your IP address, the timing and the public keys involved, and events you publish are public. We do not operate these relays, and removing something from them is best effort.

lan.title: Local network bridge:
lan.description: When you switch it on, a paired computer can send signing requests to the app directly over your local network, encrypted end to end, without relays or our servers. It is off by default and has to be switched on each time.

sameDevice.title: Signing for apps on this iPhone:
sameDevice.description: The "Sign with Nostr WoT" action extension signs requests from other apps on the same phone. It makes no network connections.

hostedWallet.title: Hosted Lightning wallet:
hostedWallet.description: If you set up the wallet held by us, the app connects to zaps.nostr-wot.com. The Hosted Lightning wallet section below lists what we store.

nwc.title: Your own wallet (Nostr Wallet Connect):
nwc.description: If you connect an external wallet, its connection string stays in your vault. Payment requests go encrypted to the relay named in that connection and on to your wallet provider, whose own policy applies.

spark.title: Self-custodial wallet (Breez SDK, Spark):
spark.description: The self-custodial wallet runs on the Spark network through the Breez SDK. Its keys come from your seed phrase and stay on your phone, but the Spark operators, Breez among them, process the payment data needed to run the wallet and see your IP address. See the <breez>Breez privacy policy</breez> and the <spark>Spark privacy policy</spark>.

lightningAddress.title: Paying a Lightning address:
lightningAddress.description: When you pay a Lightning address, the app asks the domain in that address for an invoice, as any Lightning wallet does.

tor.title: Tor (optional):
tor.description: You can route the app's traffic through Tor, which is built into the app. With Tor on, relays, remote signing, the Archive, wallet requests and images go through Tor and do not see your IP address. The local network bridge and the self-custodial wallet do not use Tor. Tor is off by default.

favicons.title: Site icons:
favicons.description: To show the icon of a connected site, the app asks <google>Google's favicon service</google> (www.google.com/s2/favicons), which receives that site's domain and your IP address. The app does not contact Google for icons while Tor is on. Your own profile pictures load from the address set in your Nostr profile.

feedback.title: Feedback links:
feedback.description: "Report a bug" and "Request a feature" open a GitHub issue form on a public repository in your browser. A bug report comes prefilled with the app version, iOS version, device model and app language. You can edit it before sending, and what you submit is public and handled under <github>GitHub's privacy statement</github>.

hostedWallet.title: Hosted Lightning wallet (zaps.nostr-wot.com)
hostedWallet.description: The hosted wallet is optional. It is custodial: we hold its balance for you. If you use it, we store:

identity.title: Your Nostr public key:
identity.description: It identifies your wallet. The app proves that you own it by signing each sign-in request; your private key is never sent.

wallet.title: Wallet records:
wallet.description: The internal identifiers of your wallet and its account, and your balance.

address.title: Lightning address:
address.description: The username you claim (name@zaps.nostr-wot.com). It is public, and anyone can look it up from your public key.

payments.title: Payments and app connections:
payments.description: Invoices, amounts, dates and the status of payments you send and receive, and any app connections (NWC) you create, with their limits.

requests.title: Request data:
requests.description: Your IP address is used for rate limiting and kept in memory for about a minute. Our server logs record request paths and errors so we can run and secure the service.

hostedWallet.custody: Because the wallet is custodial, we can move its funds, and your balance depends on our service. Keep only small amounts in it.
hostedWallet.retention: We keep these records while your hosted wallet exists. When you delete it, we delete your Lightning address, your app connections, the wallet with its payment history and the link between your public key and the wallet.

privacyMode.title: Privacy mode
privacyMode.description: With privacy mode on, the app stops recording its activity log, when each paired client was last active and the profiles of other people you viewed. You can also clear the activity log at any time.

doesNot.title: What the app does not do

items.analytics: No analytics, crash reporting or telemetry
items.tracking: No tracking across apps or websites, and no advertising identifier
items.sell: We do not sell or share your data
items.keys: We never receive your private keys, seed phrase, password or PIN

delete.title: Deleting your data
delete.description: You can delete your data from inside the app:

account.title: One account:
account.description: Remove it from the Accounts screen. Its keys, permissions and sign-in grants are deleted from this phone.

everything.title: Everything on this phone:
everything.description: "Delete all data" in Settings erases the vault, every account, permissions, pairings, the Archive and wallet data from this phone. Uninstalling the app removes them too. Back up your seed phrase first: without it, your keys cannot be recovered.

hostedWallet.title: Hosted wallet:
hostedWallet.description: When you delete all data, the app asks you separately whether to delete your hosted wallet on our server as well. If you say yes, we delete it as described above. Move any balance out first.

relays.title: Nostr relays:
relays.description: Events you published are stored on relays we do not control. Relays may honour a deletion request, but we cannot guarantee that they remove anything.

delete.contact: If you no longer have the app, or have a question about your data, reach us through the

children.title: Children
children.description: The app is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has set up a hosted wallet, contact us and we will delete it.

oracle.title: WoT Oracle API
oracle.intro: If you use the public WoT Oracle API (directly or through the extension in Remote mode):

queryData.title: Query Data:
queryData.description: The pubkeys you query for social distance calculations

ipAddress.title: IP Address:
ipAddress.description: Used for rate limiting (100 requests/minute per IP)

timestamps.title: Request Timestamps:
timestamps.description: For rate limiting and abuse prevention

items.noLog: We do not log query history long-term
items.noAssociate: We do not associate queries with identities
items.noTrack: We do not track which websites make queries

selfHosting.title: Self-Hosting
selfHosting.descriptionContinued: . This gives you complete control over your query data.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.intro: Our website uses the following third-party services:

googleAnalytics.title: Google Analytics
googleAnalytics.description: We use Google Analytics to analyze website traffic. Google may collect and process data according to their
googleAnalytics.configured: . We have configured Google Analytics to:

recaptcha.title: Google reCAPTCHA
recaptcha.description: Our contact form uses Google reCAPTCHA v3 to prevent spam. This service may collect hardware and software information. See Google's

resend.title: Resend
resend.description: We use Resend to process contact form submissions. Your contact information is transmitted to Resend to deliver emails. See Resend's

nostrRelays.title: Nostr Relays
nostrRelays.description: In Local mode, the extension connects directly to Nostr relays to fetch follow lists. These are public Nostr relays; their data handling practices vary. The extension only fetches public Kind 3 (follow list) events.

analytics.title: Analytics Data:
analytics.description: Retained by Google Analytics for 14 months

contactForm.title: Contact Form Submissions:
contactForm.description: Retained in our email system until the inquiry is resolved

extensionData.title: Extension Data:
extensionData.description: Stored locally in your browser until you clear it or uninstall the extension

appData.title: Nostr WoT App Data:
appData.description: Stored on your phone until you remove the account, delete all data or uninstall the app

hostedWallet.title: Hosted Wallet Records:
hostedWallet.description: Kept while your hosted wallet exists and deleted when you delete it

rateLimit.title: Oracle Rate Limit Data:
rateLimit.description: IP-based rate limit counters expire after 1 minute

access.title: Access:
access.description: Request information about data we hold about you

deletion.title: Deletion:
deletion.description: Request deletion of your personal data

optOut.title: Opt-out:
optOut.description: Disable Google Analytics tracking using browser tools

control.title: Control:
control.description: Clear extension data at any time through browser settings

portability.title: Portability:
portability.description: Export your local graph data from the extension

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
changes.significant: For significant changes, we may provide additional notice such as adding a statement to our homepage or sending you a notification.
